base.note: The base contract is left byte-identical because an owner-approved admission record binds it through data/phase2-owner-admission-packet.json. This amendment is a later record that reads on top of it; it does not edit it. If the base contract ever changes, this binding fails and the amendment stops applying.

removedProhibition: national per-cell geometry or polygon materialization
retainedProhibitions: production claims using illustrative or unadmitted geometry
authorizationText: I give you authorization to override the prohibition and execute the plan in full, then implement it into the website.
scope: Materialization and publication of per-cell forest-loss geometry for the 38 annual intervals 1984-1985 through 2021-2022, derived from the phase2-real-loss-component-inventory-1984-2022-v1 lineage.
unchangedByThisAmendment: expert-review-100-per-province remains unsatisfied, and this amendment does not move it.
The published province and national loss rates are unchanged; no rate is restated from per-cell geometry.
phase2-formal-exit-status is unchanged, and no exit criterion moves because this work exists.
nationalPerCellGeometryMaterialized stays false in the zonal aggregation sidecar, because the province aggregate was not and is not computed from materialized per-cell geometry.
The prohibition on converting nodata or Unknown into observed non-loss is untouched and binds this work in full.
note: An owner authorization permits the work. It is not evidence that any review, comparison, or admission occurred, and no gate is moved by this amendment.
